title: Homepage photos & videos

fields.label: Background photo
fields.name: mm_hero_image
fields.instructions: Shown behind the headline under a dark overlay (also the still frame for the video). Landscape, at least 1920 x 1080, under 400 KB (WebP or JPG). Ideas: friends laughing while opening gifts, hands passing a wrapped gift, a Christmas table with gifts and parol lights. Keep the main subject on the right half.

fields.label: Background video (optional)
fields.name: mm_hero_video
fields.instructions: Short silent loop that plays instead of the photo. MP4 (H.264), 6 to 12 seconds, 1280 x 720, under 3 MB, slow movement (bokeh lights, gift wrapping, a party table). Phones on data saver and visitors who turn off motion see the photo instead.

fields.message: Three photo cards shown after "How it works". The section appears once at least one photo is added. Use the same shape for all three: portrait 4:5, about 900 x 1125, under 200 KB.

fields.label: Office party
fields.name: mm_aud_office
fields.instructions: Coworkers at an office Christmas party or exchanging gifts at work.

fields.label: Family
fields.name: mm_aud_family
fields.instructions: A family at Noche Buena or opening gifts together (lolo, lola, kids).

fields.label: Barkada
fields.name: mm_aud_friends
fields.instructions: A group of friends at a holiday get-together, a selfie with gifts, or a classroom exchange.

fields.label: Weekly Drops photo
fields.name: mm_drops_image
fields.instructions: Shown above the example timeline. Small wrapped gifts or treats (chocolates, socks, a mug) with a little name tag. Landscape 3:2, about 1200 x 800, under 250 KB.

fields.label: Background photo
fields.name: mm_final_image
fields.instructions: Behind "Ready for this year's exchange?" under a dark overlay. Landscape 1920 x 800, under 300 KB. Ideas: close-up of wrapped gifts with warm string lights, a Christmas tree with presents.

fields.label: Background video (optional)
fields.name: mm_final_video
fields.instructions: Silent MP4 loop, 6 to 12 seconds, 1280 x 720, under 3 MB. Ideas: twinkling lights, a ribbon being tied, snow-like bokeh.

description: Optional photos and looping videos for template-homepage.php. Empty slots keep the current design.
